servinfo.title: Accessory Drive Belt Auto Tensioner / Idler Pulley Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Remove drive belt idler pulley bolt (1) and then remove drive belt idler pulley (2).
Remove accessory drive belt auto tensioner upper bolt (3) and lower bolt (4) and then remove the tensioner (5).

attention3.ptxt: Keep the removed accessory drive belt auto tensioner in upright position as much as possible. Do not leave the tensioner tilted to 45° or more for longer than 24 hours.

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Accessory Drive Belt Auto Tensioner / Idler Pulley Inspection:K12C-ISG

s1.ptxt: Install drive belt idler pulley (2) and accessory drive belt auto tensioner (5) and then tighten drive belt idler pulley bolt (1), accessory drive belt auto tensioner upper bolt (3) and lower bolt (4) to specified torque.

torqueitem.t-part: Accessory drive belt auto tensioner upper bolt
Accessory drive belt auto tensioner lower bolt

s1.ptxt: Using special tool, compress accessory drive belt auto tensioner (1) fully.

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when compressing the accessory drive belt auto tensioner can cause damage to the tensioner.

item.ptxt: Compress the tensioner slowly using special tool.
Do not apply a force of more than 150 N·m (15.3 kgf-m, 111.0 lbf-ft) when compressing the tensioner.
